designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized the Secretary of the Interior to acquire and protect lands along the Maryland shore of the Potomac to preserve the view from Mount Vernon and Fort Washington.
designationHistory.note: The 1961 joint resolution does not use the name 'Piscataway Park'; the name was applied later. No naming action was found.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (p. 61), 'Authorized Oct. 4, 1961'
